newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha unchanged, swaps flat, barges talk $18.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha unchanged, swaps flat, barges talk $18.

text.p: NWE naphtha was unchanged on Monday amid sluggish demand from petrochemical companies and steady supplies of full range grades.
"Some of the fob availabilities have disappeared but we still see enough product on offer," said a petrochemical buyer.

Full range cargoes were pegged around $1 a tonne above quotes with light product nearer $2.50 above. Swaps talked $180 for July, August and September although at least brokers saw a 25 cents backwardation between July and September.
Barges in Rotterdam were pegged around $185 fob but buyers were tough to find.
